description: Part 10 lesson 10-02, route without RPG III (fixed-form RPG IV, CRTBNDRPG), issue #35. RUN 2026-10-04 (one connection, ran to the end; results in expected/notes.md and docs/probes.md). JU0300 and TK0100 come from the real CVTRPGSRC output under src/legacy/qrpgle112. The first run used an earlier text of solutions/10-02/ju0300-credit-4x.rpgle whose base D specs were hand-written; the file has since been rebased onto the real conversion (two D spec lines), so a RE-RUN is needed to compile that exact text. WHAT IT CHECKS: (1) CRTBNDRPG of the credit version (member JU0300C, event file and compile messages) and the count of OVER LIMIT detail lines in the QSYSPRT copy of a submitted JU0300 run, 0 before, 8 with TOKYSN 0, 2 with TOKYSN 10000, 0 for the restored original; (2) DSPPGMREF of the ILE programs (all programs, *SRVPGM, TK0100 and JU0300 alone, the new JU0300) and DSPDBR; (3) the CPYSRCF of the lesson step 9 into a scratch member, with row counts; (4) the ILE message sequence after CPF4131: a probe program (src/v10prb.rpgle, compiled before CHGPF, called after it) and the real TK0100 submitted in batch and ended by ENDJOB. ORDER: helper compiles, RMVLIBLE of library 1 (TXRNOL), DBVER 1 + RPG III gate, attribute gate, TOKYSN gate (SQL fails when the column is absent = pass), backup of TOKUIM to TKUIMRG in the B library (fresh name, DLTF first), TXLEGACY LANG(*RPGLE) FORCE(*YES), scratch compiles, post-switch gate (else jump to RSTLEG), impact survey, probe and original JU0300 runs, CHGPF TOKUIM from TOKUIMV3, probe and TK0100 runs, TOKUIL1 rebuild, TK0100 recompile, credit JU0300 build and two runs, TOKUIM restored from TKUIMRG (RSTGUARD jumps to RSTLEG if the backup is missing), original JU0300 rebuilt and run, then RSTLEG: TXLEGACY LANG(*RPG) FORCE(*YES), TXRESET, final-state rows. TKUIMRG stays in the B library on purpose (delete by hand when the result is accepted). Wrapper name TPART1002R. Recovery by hand if the run stops: see expected/notes.md.

steps.label: GATE1
steps.cmd:

MONMSG MSGID(CPF9801 CPF9810) EXEC(DO)
SNDPGMMSG MSGID(CPF9898) MSGF(QCPFMSG) MSGDTA('GATE STOP: DBVER is not 1 or the legacy language is not RPG III - nothing was changed') TOPGMQ(*SAME) MSGTYPE(*INFO)
GOTO CMDLBL(DONE)
ENDDO

steps.cmd:

MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000 SQL0000)

MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000 SQL0000)
RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/VFYGCK SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS(''&LIB'', ''*PGM'')) X WHERE OBJNAME IN (''ZA0500'', ''JU0300'', ''TK0100'') AND OBJATTRIBUTE = ''RPG''') COMMIT(*NONE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000 SQL0000) EXEC(DO)
SNDPGMMSG MSGID(CPF9898) MSGF(QCPFMSG) MSGDTA('GATE STOP: ZA0500 JU0300 TK0100 are not all RPG III - nothing was changed') TOPGMQ(*SAME) MSGTYPE(*INFO)
GOTO CMDLBL(DONE)
ENDDO

MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000 SQL0000) EXEC(GOTO CMDLBL(MKBK))
CHKOBJ OBJ(QTEMP/NOGATE) OBJTYPE(*DTAARA)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF9801 CPF9810) EXEC(DO)
SNDPGMMSG MSGID(CPF9898) MSGF(QCPFMSG) MSGDTA('PREGATE STOP: TOKUIM already has TOKYSN - restore by hand') TOPGMQ(*SAME) MSGTYPE(*INFO)
GOTO CMDLBL(DONE)
ENDDO
